verdict.rationale: Pika documents its own programmatic surfaces: an API ('Pika API Club', one API for 100+ video, image, audio and LLM models) and a Pika MCP that brings '40+ creative apps and 100+ gen media models' into agent conversations. That suggests much of the UI's app catalog is reachable without the web UI, but nothing documents that the API itself exposes those creative apps or that it matches the UI feature for feature. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API reference docs showing app-level endpoints (e.g., Swap Anything, Pikaframes, character creation, editing tools), account/asset management via API, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
